snippet.title: Best Daytrip from Tokyo: Explore Traditional Kawagoe (Little Edo)
snippet.description:
Kawagoe, known as Little Edo, is a great day trip from Tokyo - just 40 minutes from Ikebukuro Station. Here, you can walk through the old warehouse district with traditional kurazukuri black buildings and visit historic sites like Hikawa Shrine, Kumano Shrine, Kita-in Temple, and the Bell Tower (Toki no Kane). Don’t miss Kashiya Yokocho, a street full of nostalgic candy shops. Try local specialties like matcha noodles and sweet potato treats. There are also craft shops and seasonal festivals, including Children’s Day with koinobori flying overhead. A perfect spot to experience Japan’s history and culture outside the city.

📍 Honkawagoe Station - 〒350-0043 Saitama, Kawagoe, 新富町１丁目２２
🕒 shops are open at around 10am - 5pm
📌 Tobu Toju Line to Kawagoe station or Kawagoe-shi station, Fukutoshin Line + Seibu Shinjuku Line to Honkawagoe Station
📌 Festivals & Events: Kawagoe Festival (Third Saturday and Sunday of October), Kawagoe Million Lights Summer Festival (Late July), Kawagoe Fireworks Festival (Late July)

snippet.title: 埼玉県川越市大正浪漫夢通りライブカメラ
snippet.description:
川越市は、埼玉県の北西部に位置し、歴史と伝統、そして現代が見事に融合する、まさに唯一無二の景観が広がる都市です。

この地域の景色は、江戸時代の町並みと現代の都市機能、豊かな自然環境が織りなす、他では見られない特別な風景を生み出しています。

 

四季の変化が鮮明に表現される川越の景色は、まさに日本の歴史と自然の芸術作品と言えるでしょう

。春には、川越城址公園の桜並木が淡いピンクの花を咲かせ、伝統的な蔵造りの町並みと見事に調和します。

特に、小江戸と呼ばれる川越の歴史的町並みに咲く桜は、まさに川越にしか存在しない唯一無二の風景です。

 

夏は、伝統的な蔵造りの町並みと近代的な都市景観が融合した景色が広がります。

川越の中心市街地では、歴史的な建造物と現代の建築が共存し、まるで絵はがきのような美しさを醸し出します。

特に夕暮れ時の蔵造りの街並みは、他では見られない独特の魅力を放っています。

 

秋になると、川越市内の寺社や公園が鮮やかな紅葉に染まります。

特に、喜多院や川越城址公園の紅葉は、まるで自然が描いた絵画のようで、歴史的な建造物と紅葉のコントラストは息をのむほどの美しさです。

 

冬は、伝統的な町並みと雪景色が、静寂と美しさを演出します。

蔵造りの町並みに雪が積もる様子は、まさに川越にしか存在しない、唯一無二の景観を作り出します。

 

歴史と伝統、そして現代が見事に融合する川越景観をお楽しみください。

また、システムの不具合や混雑による電波状況の悪化により、配信が一時停止することがあります。

snippet.title: Kawagoe: Why Japan’s “Little Edo” Has Such Heavy Walls
snippet.description:
Why did Kawagoe’s merchants build these heavy kura-style shops, and how old is the street we see?
The walls were a fire defence that merchants chose after the great fire of 1893. One surviving 1792 house gave them the proof, later buildings were layered in, and since 1999 the district has been nationally protected, with exterior changes reviewed. Kawagoe looks old because its merchants rebuilt for fire and the street they built is still kept, not because it stayed untouched since the Edo period.

snippet.title: Kawagoe Day Trip from Tokyo: Little Edo Food & Sights 🍠
snippet.description:
Step back in time at Kawagoe, known as “Little Edo,” one of the easiest day trips from Tokyo! 🏯🍠

Just 30 minutes from Ikebukuro, this old town has black-walled warehouses, a 1,500-year-old shrine, a historic bell tower, and a candy alley packed with sweet potato treats. It’s also far less crowded than Kamakura or Enoshima.

In this video, we explore Hikawa Shrine, Kashiya Yokocho (Candy Alley), and Kurazukuri Street, and eat our way through Kawagoe’s famous sweet potato snacks.

📍 PLACES MENTIONED

Hikawa Shrine
Shingashi River
Kashiya Yokocho (Candy Alley)
Kasho Umon (sweet potato ice cream, warabi mochi, imo koi)
Kamadashi Mitsuimo Hokuhoku (sweet potato croissant)
Toki no Kane (Bell of Time, rings at 6am, 12pm, 3pm, 6pm)
Takosen
Koedo Osatsuan (sweet potato chips)

🚆 HOW TO GET THERE

Ikebukuro to Kawagoe: about 30 minutes
Shinjuku to Kawagoe: about 1 hour
Take the bus from platform 7 outside Kawagoe Station
Get the 1 Day Tobu Pass for unlimited local bus rides

snippet.title: 【東京近郊自駕】成田機場出發，小江戶川越藏造老街、結緣聖地冰川神社！第一次吃一蘭拉麵、全家超商早餐意外好吃！埼玉縣旅遊、日本自由行Saitama Vlog(上集)
snippet.description:
哈囉哈大家～這趟五月日本自駕旅遊紀錄（埼玉縣、群馬縣）
這篇為關東埼玉縣上集，群馬下集我還沒開始剪～ＸＤ
剛好遇到九月要去四國環島11天，可能群馬要等回國後再來努力了！

** 旅遊日期2026/5/14~17 **

五月快閃日本四天，室友沒假了！就是硬要安排個四天出國啦～
出國就是開心～～～畢竟我的夢想是玩完全日本47都道府縣
（I LOVE JAPAN!!）

因為旅遊天數很短，只能挑一些想去的景點為主，所以分了兩天自駕玩兩個縣市（真的很趕～）
埼玉縣主要去兩個大景點，川越老街、冰川神社
住在川越市區一晚，當天晚上還第一次吃一蘭
去過日本這麼多次卻完全沒吃過～鄉下俗！

旅遊資訊分享：
1.租車公司－NICONICO RENT A CAR成田機場店
2.川越住宿－川越王子大飯店Kawagoe Prince Hotel
（住宿有配合的停車場，辦理入住手續時可與櫃檯告知有開車）
3.川越老街免費停車場－初雁公園停車場

snippet.description:

A renowned sushi restaurant located in Kawagoe, Saitama — Kō Sushi.
Established in 1878.

With meticulous preparation and masterful craftsmanship, their authentic Edomae sushi shines through in every piece. Loved for generations by local customers in Kawagoe and sushi enthusiasts alike 🍣✨

In this video,
we take you behind the scenes of the traditional techniques passed down at Kō Sushi,
showcasing the care and skill poured into each carefully crafted piece of Edomae nigiri.

We hopped on a train using the Kawagoe Discount Pass to explore one of the most charming towns just outside of Tokyo. Only 30 minutes away, Kawagoe is full of traditional streets, old merchant warehouses, and retro vibes. It’s like stepping back in time!
In this video, we’ll take you along as we stroll down the famous Kurazukuri Street, snack our way through Kashiya Yokocho (Candy Alley), and make a wish at the peaceful Kumano Shrine. You’ll also see how we used the Kawagoe Discount Pass to save money on transportation!

snippet.description:
Exploring Kawagoe feels like strolling through a tunnel of time, with each step paying homage to years gone by. Join me as we ride the tram, traversing modern clamor to reach Kawagoe, acclaimed as "Little Edo." Along the bustling shopping street, we amble through streets imbued with Edo period charm, experiencing the blend of ancient culture and contemporary life. And as we step into Kashiya Yokocho, it's like stepping into a tantalizing candy world, every corner brimming with sweet memories and delightful fantasies.
